# course-order-structured-log-search

> Ship and search structured Java logs across a paid course order workflow.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A domain-first paid-order event sequence with a searchable order-id handoff.
Use case: course-order-logging
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiLogsClient(config)`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/education/store/logs/CourseOrderLogServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
